title: PMOS Diagnostic Device
description: A device that collects standarized measurements of androgen-related physical changes, such as hair density, hair growth, and sebum production for patients with PMOS

title: Novel Speculum
description: A new speculum that uses softer and thermally comfortable materials, and integrated pressure and temperature sensors to improve patient comfort during pap smears and other gynecological exams.

title: Acute Fluid Balance Detection Device
description: A non-invasive device that monitors physiological changes following controlled water intake.
